§6Guidance Computer§f is the flight controller for every AR rocket. It is a single block linked to the Rocket Assembling Machine via a Linker, and it reads the Planet ID Chip to set the destination dimension.

Without a Guidance Computer, the assembler will not spawn a rocket entity. The computer stores destination ID, return trip settings, and max safe altitude.

Right-click the Guidance Computer with a researched Planet ID Chip to set the destination. An unresearched chip will not bind and the GUI reports 'Invalid destination'.

§ePS:§f The Guidance Computer also drives the Planet Holo Selector, giving you a 3D preview of the destination world. It is the single most important infrastructure tile for any planetary mission.
